info.name: PROPCRM Client API v1
info.description:
Mobile REST API for the client (trader) surface.

Base URL is `{{base_url}}` (default http://localhost:8000).

## How to use
1. Run **Auth → Login**. The test script stores `access_token` automatically.
2. If the account has 2FA on, login returns `two_factor_required: true` and a `challenge_token`. Run **Auth → Two-Factor Verify** with the TOTP code — that swaps it for a real `access_token`.
3. Everything else inherits the bearer token from the collection.

## Envelope
Every endpoint returns `{success, message, data, errors, meta}`. List endpoints fill `meta` with `current_page / per_page / total / total_pages / has_next`.

## Token abilities
The pre-TOTP challenge token only carries `two-factor:verify`; real access tokens carry `mobile:full`. Protected routes require `mobile:full`, so a challenge token cannot reach them.
